Hyperscale at $38 billion was approximately 50% of data center revenue and increased 12% quarter over quarter. ACIE revenue was $37 billion and grew 31% quarter over quarter.
We generated record free cash flow of $49 billion, up from $35 billion in Q4.
We returned a record $20 billion to our shareholders.
We increased our total supply inclusive of inventory purchase commitments on prepaids to $145 billion.
Total revenue for Q2 is expected to be $91 billion, plus or minus 2%.
We have visibility to nearly $20 billion in total CPU revenue this year from standalone Vera CPUs.
Giving us full confidence in $1 trillion in Blackwell and Rubin revenue we foresee from 2025 through calendar 2027.
GAAP gross margin was 74.9%, and non-GAAP gross margin was 75%.

Sovereign revenue increased more than 80% year over year. NVIDIA AI infrastructure is now deployed across nearly 40 countries.
Physical AI continues to gain momentum exceeding $9 billion in revenue over the last 12 months.
Spectrum-X is now larger than all Ethernet network peers combined. InfiniBand grew more than 4x year over year.
The price of renting an H100 has risen 20% year to date, while A100 cloud pricing is up nearly 15%.
Increasing quarterly dividend from $0.01 to $0.25 per share and announcing an $80 billion share repurchase authorization in addition to $39 billion remaining on current plan.
